text: Minimal Omni 是面向 DSH Web profile 的按需能力插件，通过 profile bundle 添加 Minimal Omni preset，并提供 request_capability 和 release_capability。会话可按任务启用代码搜索与 LSP、网页抓取、浏览器、文档提取、Jobs 或 Goal；释放能力时卸载对应工具并清理资源。适合希望保持默认工具精简、需要时再使用浏览器、文档或代码导航的 DSH Web 用户。浏览器需可用的 Playwright；未发现额外 API key 要求。

Minimal Omni adds an on-demand preset to DSH Web. Use request_capability to enable code, web, browser, document, Jobs, or Goal tools for a task, then release them. Browser use requires Playwright. No extra API key is required.
想让 DSH 需要时再打开浏览器或代码工具。
有没有办法在会话里临时启用网页抓取，用完再关掉？
I want browser and coding tools to appear only when a task needs them.
Minimal Omni 的「按需租用能力」：会话调用 request_capability 选择代码、网页、浏览器、文档、Jobs 或 Goal，插件挂载对应工具；调用 release_capability 后卸载能力并释放其资源。
Minimal Omni 的「文档检查与提取」：启用 documents 后，可检查工作区文档元信息、列出 ZIP 或 Office 包条目，并对支持的文本、PDF、DOCX、XLSX、PPTX 或 ZIP 文件提取有界内容。
Minimal Omni 启用 web 能力后会提供 web_fetch 获取会话指定网页；代码没有固定目标主机，也未见该功能要求专用 API key。

@rain/minimal-omni README · **Minimal Omni**：On-demand tools for a minimal-by-default DeepSeek Harness session.

Request browser, document and code-navigation capabilities when a task needs them, then release them without changing your model, provider or credentials.

@rain/minimal-omni README · **Minimal Omni**：

@rain/minimal-omni README · Project status：Minimal Omni is an independent developer-preview plugin loaded through the DSH profile-bundle interface. You continue to use the official Web app. The supported capabilities and runtime pin are documented below.

@rain/minimal-omni README · Why use it?：| | A large tool setup | Minimal Omni |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tools visible at idle | Many, depending on the setup | `pwsh`, `str_replace_editor`, `request_capability`, `release_capability` |
| Browser | Always present or configured separately | Requested only when needed |
| Documents | Depends on the setup | Requested only when needed |
| Planning or reviewer prompts | Depends on the setup | None added by this package |
| Uninstall | Varies by setup | One DSH plugin command |

@rain/minimal-omni README · Why use it?：The model remains the official Minimal brain. The surrounding runtime supplies
the tools and cleanup; it does not add a planner or a review loop.

@rain/minimal-omni README · Install：Run this once in the DSH environment you already use:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Rainflowers686/deepseek-harness-minimal-omni#v0.2.0-preview.2
```

The command adds one bundle to the existing `web` profile. It does not change
the default preset, provider, model, credentials, proxy, or permissions.

@rain/minimal-omni README · Use：Start the normal Web profile:

```powershell
dsh --profile web
```

Create a new session, open **Agent preset**, and select **Minimal Omni**.
Standard and other installed presets remain available.

For a coding task, the idle surface stays small. If the task needs a current
web page, a PDF, or repository navigation, the session can request Browser,
Documents, or Code/LSP for that task and release it afterwards.

@rain/minimal-omni README · Uninstall：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove @rain/minimal-omni
```

Removing the bundle leaves the rest of the Web profile and your sessions and
credentials in place. Install the pinned command again if you want to return.

@rain/minimal-omni README · What is included：See the [capability matrix](docs/CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md) for the evidence-based
support tiers. In brief, this preview includes the Minimal brain, on-demand
Code/LSP, Browser, Web fetch, PDF/DOCX/ZIP extraction, Jobs, native Goal and
manual `/compact`, session reload, and an integrated coding path.

@rain/minimal-omni README · What is included：XLSX and PPTX model-facing workflows, Goal continuity across a successful
compaction, automatic compaction tuning, and optional media extraction are
Experimental. Vision is Conditional on the selected route supporting image
input. Web Search and authenticated GitHub actions need their own provider or
authorization. Desktop automation, ASR, broad audio/video understanding, and
cross-Agent handoff are Deferred.

@rain/minimal-omni README · What is included：Minimal Omni does not ship a custom `0.68` compaction override as a stable
default; automatic compaction tuning remains Experimental.

@rain/minimal-omni README · Compatibility：The package requires Node.js 22.19+ and PowerShell 7. The tested runtime is `dsh-v0.1.2-rc.1` at commit
`a66e4702047846cdaa10c66c9d3df3951f5ea70d`. Windows is the first supported
platform. See [COMPATIBILITY.md](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) before trying another
DSH build.

@rain/minimal-omni README · Security notes：- Capability tools use the current session workspace and bounded output.
- Browser profiles, downloads, screenshots, and jobs are owned by the runtime.
- Known unsupported Vision routes are rejected before an image tool is used.
- Acceptance/CI mode has stricter request and home-isolation checks; normal
  community use does not require an acceptance ledger or an artificial request
  budget.
- Do not paste API keys, cookies, or private session logs into an issue.

@rain/minimal-omni README · Docs and contributing：- [Capability matrix](docs/CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md): verified, conditional, experimental and deferred capabilities.
- [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md): installation, presets, browser, Vision and provider problems.
- [Development](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) and [contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): local checks and requirements for new capabilities.
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): changes between preview releases.

@rain/minimal-omni README · Docs and contributing：Static and packaging checks need no provider key. For a compatibility report, include the DSH and plugin versions, reproduction steps and a redacted error message.

@rain/minimal-omni README · 项目状态：Minimal Omni 是独立的开发者预览插件，通过 DSH 的 profile bundle 接口加载，官方 Web 应用继续作为使用入口。当前支持范围和运行时版本见下文。

@rain/minimal-omni README · 为什么使用它？：| | 工具较多的配置 | Minimal Omni |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 空闲时可见的工具 | 取决于配置，通常较多 | `pwsh`、`str_replace_editor`、`request_capability`、`release_capability` |
| 浏览器 | 可能一直存在 | 需要时才申请 |
| 文档工具 | 取决于配置 | 需要时才申请 |
| 规划或审查提示 | 取决于配置 | 本包不会额外加入 |
| 卸载 | 取决于配置 | 一条 DSH 插件命令 |

模型仍然使用官方 Minimal brain。额外工作由运行时负责，不会加入 planner 或
reviewer loop。

@rain/minimal-omni README · 安装：在平时使用的 DSH 环境中执行一次：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Rainflowers686/deepseek-harness-minimal-omni#v0.2.0-preview.2
```

这条命令只向现有 `web` profile 增加一个 bundle，不会修改默认 preset、
provider、模型、凭据、代理或权限。

@rain/minimal-omni README · 使用：正常启动 Web profile：

```powershell
dsh --profile web
```

新建会话，打开 **Agent preset**，选择 **Minimal Omni**。Standard 和其它
已经安装的 preset 仍然可用。

一般编码任务开始时工具很少。需要当前网页、PDF 或仓库导航时，会话可以申请
Browser、Documents 或 Code/LSP，完成后再释放。

@rain/minimal-omni README · 卸载：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove @rain/minimal-omni
```

卸载只移除 Minimal Omni bundle，不会删除会话、凭据或其它 preset。需要时再
执行上面的固定版本安装命令即可恢复。

@rain/minimal-omni README · 能力范围：请查看[能力分层矩阵](docs/CAPABILITY_MATRIX_CN.md)。本预览已支持并经过验证的
范围包括 Minimal brain、按需 Code/LSP、Browser、Web fetch、PDF/DOCX/ZIP 提取、
Jobs、native Goal、手动 `/compact`、session reload 和完整编码闭环。

XLSX/PPTX 的 model-facing 工作流、成功 compaction 后的 Goal 连续性、automatic
compaction 调参和可选媒体提取属于 Experimental。Vision 取决于所选 route 是否
支持图像输入；Web Search 和已授权 GitHub 操作需要另外的 provider/授权。桌面
自动化、ASR、广义音视频理解和跨 Agent handoff 暂不在范围内。

本包没有把自定义 `0.68` compaction 阈值设为稳定默认值；自动 compaction 调参仍属于 Experimental。

@rain/minimal-omni README · 安全提示：- capability 工具使用当前会话工作区，并限制输出大小。 - 浏览器 profile、下载、截图和 Jobs 由运行时创建和清理。 - 已知不支持图像输入的 Vision route 会在使用图像工具前返回不可用。 - acceptance/CI 模式有更严格的请求和 DSH_HOME 检查；普通用户不需要 ledger 或人为的请求预算。 - Issue 中不要粘贴 API key、cookie 或含私人内容的完整 session log。 更多信息见 [SECURITY.md](docs/SECURITY.md) 和 [TROUBLESHOOTING.md](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)。
